description: Search or list layers in the geo.admin ech MapServer catalogue (all federal geospatial layers). Returns layer ids that identify_map_layer and find_map_features accept. Without a query, returns the first page of layers alphabetically.

owner.description: Optional data-owner filter (e.g. swisstopo, BAFU, BFS).

query.description: Words matched against the layer id, name, owner, and abstract (e.g. 'municipality', 'gemeinde', 'avalanche').

name: search_map_layers
